DISTANT WATERFALL RIBBON — white thread of meltwater falling from a high dark cliff-face in the deep background, barely a hairline against the rock-wall, scale-prover for the entire bloom-valley below.

GLACIAL ERRATIC BOULDER — single house-sized granite erratic resting alone on the bloom-carpet, ice-age refugee, lichen-crusted and pitted, its mass dwarfed by the bloom-field stretching unbroken to the far ridge.

DISTANT RAIN-CURTAIN — blue-grey veil of rainfall descending from a single cloud-base onto a far ridge, oblique and gauze-like, dimming the bloom-colour beneath it, scale-prover for the wide valley it is slowly crossing.

LONE STANDING STONE — single rough-hewn megalith rising from the bloom-carpet, lichen-orange on its windward face, its vertical axis anchoring the eye while the bloom-meadow rolls away on every side into deep distance.

SINGLE HUMMINGBIRD HOVERING — ruby-throated hummingbird suspended at a foreground bloom-cluster, wings a vibrational blur, beak inserted in a specific floret, its jewel-scale throwing the vast bloom-slope behind it into vertiginous proportion.

WILD HORSE HERD MIDGROUND — small band of wild horses crossing the steppe-bloom in middle-distance, pale dust lifting behind their hooves, each animal brush-stroke-small, scale-prover for the Eurasian plain behind them.

GLACIAL MELTWATER STREAM — silver thread of meltwater winding from a high snowfield through the bloom-meadow toward the frame-edge, catching sky-colour, its lead-line drawing the eye deep into the landform's distance.

SINGLE DRAGONFLY FOREGROUND — iridescent green dragonfly perched on a bloom-stem in the extreme foreground, wings horizontal and transparent, its stillness anchoring the macro end of the scale, the bloom-carpet vast behind it.

DISTANT BASALT SEA-STACK — solitary sea-stack rising from grey offshore swell behind a coastal bloom-headland, white surf-ring at its base, the stack's verticality tiny at this range, scale-prover for the cliff-shoulder of bloom above the shore.

WINDSWEPT LONE OAK — single ancient sessile oak standing on a bloom-covered hillside, crown flattened eastward by prevailing wind, its scale-familiar form dwarfed by the hill-country of bloom rising steeply behind it.

STARLING MURMURATION CLOUD — vast organic murmuration of starlings twisting above the bloom-plain in the upper midground, the flock's shape morphing like slow smoke, its enormous span revealing the sky-volume above the landscape.

DISTANT LIGHTNING FORK — single violent lightning fork striking a far ridge-top under a dark storm-cell, the bloom-meadow briefly lit from the side by the flash, scale-prover for the weather-system dwarfing the landform beneath it.

DISTANT GLACIER-TOE — terminal ice-cliff of an alpine glacier descending from the snowfield above, blue-white and fractured at its edge, tiny in the deep background, scale-prover for the bloom-valley stretching from its meltwater to the foreground.

LONE BRISTLECONE PINE ON BLOOM-SHELF — single wind-tortured bristlecone pine clinging to a rocky ledge mid-slope, bark stripped silver, crown flattened by centuries of prevailing wind, scale-anchor for the bloom-carpet cascading below it

DISTANT RAIN-CURTAIN SWEEPING — blue-grey curtain of precipitation dragging across the far valley floor, trailing edge lit gold where it meets sunlight, scale-prover for the breadth of the bloom-plain it crosses

SINGLE BUMBLEBEE ON FOREGROUND STEM — fat bumblebee gripping a specific foreground bloom, pollen-baskets packed amber-yellow, wings slightly blurred, macro-anchor at the near end of a scale-spectrum stretching into vast distance
